mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and higher corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive demand shock.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate cuts and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to deteriorating fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST > 900.0), rising home construction fuels consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive demand shock.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
